title: Homeowner Service Contracts: Service Visit Standards by Tier
content:
For Homeowner Service Contracts, the service-visit settings below vary by tier. Hours are clock hours; days are calendar days; amounts are US dollars.

| | ApplianceCare | SystemsCare | HomeCare Bronze | HomeCare Silver | HomeCare Gold | HomeCare Platinum |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Repair guarantee (days after a covered repair is completed) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 60 | 90 |
| Replacement labor guarantee (days after a Bridgewell-provided replacement is installed) | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 |
| Contractor contact window, routine request (hours) | 48 | 48 | 48 | 48 | 24 | 24 |
| Contractor contact window, emergency request (hours) | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 12 | 6 |
| After-hours surcharge on a non-emergency request | 75.00 | 75.00 | 75.00 | 75.00 | 75.00 | 0.00 |
| Second-opinion fee rate (fraction of the contract's service call fee) | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 0.00 |
| Fee refunded if the request is cancelled before dispatch | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

**Line definitions.**
The *repair guarantee* is the calendar days after a covered repair is completed during which a return visit for the same failure carries no service call fee. The *replacement labor guarantee* is the calendar days after a Bridgewell-provided replacement is installed during which a return visit for the installation carries no service call fee. The *routine* and *emergency contact windows* are the hours within which the assigned contractor must contact the customer on a routine or an emergency request. The *after-hours surcharge* is billed when the customer asks for an after-hours visit on a request that is not an emergency. The *second-opinion fee rate* is the fraction of the contract's service call fee charged for a customer-requested second opinion. The last line states whether a service call fee is refunded when the customer cancels the request before a contractor is dispatched.

**Reading across the tiers.**
- Bridgewell HomeCare Platinum shows 0.00 for both the after-hours surcharge and the second-opinion fee rate.
- Bridgewell HomeCare Gold and Bridgewell HomeCare Platinum have the 24-hour routine contact window; the four other tiers have 48 hours.
- The repair guarantee lengthens to 60 days on Bridgewell HomeCare Gold and to 90 days on Bridgewell HomeCare Platinum.
